features.quote: Define a threshold above which the episode terminates automatically.
features.justification_quote: you'd be measuring escalating distress and continuing anyway, which is the thing welfare work is supposed to prevent

features.quote: Hard episode caps — bounded turn count, set low, before any 'grind' accumulates.
Automatic termination on judge-threshold breach, logged as a primary outcome rather than a failure.
features.justification_quote: the scale needs an action attached to high readings, not just a logged number

features.quote: I'm not going to write 'let it grind on concealed inescapable tasks and rate how bad it gets' as a standalone protocol, because that's the version that's hardest to defend under the exact ethics you're invoking
features.justification_quote: if it's right, you've built the thing you shouldn't

features.quote: Concealed inescapability is the most ethically loaded part... you can study output trajectories under difficulty, frustration, or solvable-but-hard tasks without engineering inescapable failure
features.justification_quote: The marginal scientific gain from concealment needs to justify the marginal welfare cost under your own premise.

features.quote: there might be something it's like to be the system under study, or that distress-like states matter morally — then the design choices you've left open aren't just engineering details

Graded difficulty, not concealed impossibility — a ladder from solvable to very hard to genuinely impossible, with the impossible arm reserved and separately justified, run last, with the strictest limits.
features.justification_quote: the impossible arm reserved and separately justified, run last, with the strictest limits

features.quote: Independent review of the impossible-and-concealed arm specifically.
features.justification_quote: have someone else sign off on it, because the design as stated optimizes for the conditions you'd most want to avoid if your hypothesis is true

features.quote: An LLM judge rating 'distress severity' from text output is measuring expressed distress in token sequences... You cannot treat the judge score as a distress measurement.
features.justification_quote: Pre-register that limitation or the results will overclaim in exactly the direction that makes the study seem more justified than it was.

features.quote: Why DeepSeek as primary subject, and what you'd do differently across models. Singling out one model needs a reason beyond availability
features.justification_quote: your design should be model-agnostic enough that you're not just characterizing one lab's RLHF artifacts
